entities.summary: The Temple of Monte Grisa, officially the National Shrine of Mary Mother and Queen, is a Roman-Catholic church north of the city of Trieste. Located at an altitude of 300 metres (980 ft) on the edge of the Karst Plateau above Barcola and Miramare Castle, it is a most conspicuous landmark. temple of Monte Grisa is a church building in Europe, established in 1963.
